signal: Alkira raised a $100M Series C, launched its Connect Partner Program in March 2026, and is being acquired by Lumen to combine its network-as-a-service with Lumen's fiber footprint.

email.body1:
Nathan, saw Alkira launch the Connect Partner Program and line up the Lumen tie-up after your $100M Series C.

That kind of momentum usually opens more in-market accounts than a regional team can personally cover before quota resets. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for Alkira off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Nathan, quick follow-up for Alkira.

During a partner push and an acquisition, expectations on pipeline tend to climb faster than headcount can. Most regional managers don't know exactly how many meetings they need to book to hold the number, so the gap surfaces late and the quarter gets tight.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings your region needs this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Nathan, last bit of proof for Alkira.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how your region's reply rate likely compares to peer networking-software teams. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?
email.body4:
Nathan, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling regional coverage without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. A partner push and an acquisition keep a team busy, and timing matters more than any pitch.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of 3 AI-SDR plays scoped to a regional motion? I'll tailor it to Alkira either way.
